newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Foreign funds boost investment in Colombian stocks.
newsitem.headline: Foreign funds boost investment in Colombian stocks.

text.p: Foreign funds increased their Colombian shareholdings by 27 percent in real peso terms in the year to November compared to the same period in 1995, the Securities Superintendency said Friday.
It said foreign funds held the equivalent of $1.07 billion in Colombian shares as of Nov. 30 -- up from $849 million in the same month last year. The increase in dollar terms is 26.5 percent.

Between Oct. 31 and Nov. 30 this year, foreign funds increased their portfolio investment by 1.4 percent in dollar terms, the superintendency said. The 15 funds authorized to purchase Colombian ADRs or GDRs, or global depositary receipts, had an accumulated investment of $494 million as of Nov. 30, marginally down on the October figure.
